entities.name: PMID:10752546
observations: In a canine chronic-ischemia model, TMR and TMR+bFGF increased total vascular density about 40% versus ischemic control; adding bFGF doubled large-vessel number, increased proliferating vascular-cell density 50%, and tripled estimated vascular cross-sectional area.
Authors concluded bFGF enhanced post-TMR angiogenesis mainly by enlarging vessels; regional blood flow showed no additional bFGF benefit.

entities.name: PMID:12414042
observations: In a porcine chronic-ischemia model, TMLR and rhFGF-2+TMLR increased capillary and arteriole numbers versus untreated ischemia (P<0.005).
The reported abstract did not establish a statistically significant capillary or arteriole-density advantage for rhFGF-2+TMLR over TMLR alone.

entities.name: FGF2/bFGF
observations: Basic fibroblast growth factor was used with transmyocardial laser revascularization in animal chronic-ischemia studies to assess angiogenic enhancement.

entities.name: bFGF enhances TMR angiogenesis
observations: Histologic evidence supports enhancement, most clearly through increased large-vessel formation, vascular-cell proliferation, and vascular cross-sectional area rather than a consistently demonstrated increase in capillary number over TMLR alone.
